DEPARTMENT OF GENERAL MEDICINE

BImonthly formative and summative assessment of 2017 BATCH (MBBS)

 

This is an attendance as well as a blended, bimonthly formative and summative assessment of the learning competencies of 2017 MBBS batch posted in the department of Medicine. The formative assessment is from each student logged competency around patients evaluated regularly from date of joining (left column) till date of current bimonthly summative assessment (right column), which is from the assignment posted for here May - 2021

The formative assessment has been divided into non-verbal which assesses their competency in procedural domains including empathic communication and body language and verbal which assesses their ability to communicate their work through their day to day E logs.
